godel_sentence_machine.name: GodelSentenceMachine
godel_sentence_machine.description: A timed sculpture of the Godel argument, visibly labelled as an illustration, not a proof search. For a sound, effectively axiomatized theory with sufficient arithmetic, the constructed G is true in the intended natural numbers and unprovable in that theory. The mechanism does not establish this theorem by jamming.

dna.measured: PREDICTION FALSIFIED, and the `expected` block above is left as written. It predicted frame 4.0-4.5% at framing 0.55 and a move to bites. Actual: 1.11-1.32%, statistically unchanged from the 1.29% measured at framing 1.0. framing DID apply -- the subject went from 25% to 50% of frame width, verified by counting non-background pixels -- so the prediction failed on its reasoning, not on plumbing. RUN-TO-RUN NOISE MEASURED AT +/-15%: two identical sweeps of unchanged code and registry gave rice_verifier_booth 1.32% then 1.11%, and critic_regress_stack 5.07% then 4.35%. The sweep is not deterministic, so any single-run verdict within about 15% of the 3% threshold is a coin toss reported as a fact. Numbers below are the range across both runs, not a point.
dna.remedy: THE FIX IS INK, NOT FRAMING, and slope_tangent_demo's registry note said so before this pass ran: 'no amount of reframing fixes a subject whose ink is one pixel wide.' The refusal axis mostly repaints the four MEANING cards and adds a lamp; the head panel, console, slot, RICE screen and the whole SYNTAX rack are invariant BY DESIGN, because the claim is that the booth works perfectly under all five values. Reframing multiplies the changed ink and the unchanged body by the same factor, so the ratio barely moves. To make this bite the semantic column has to carry more area -- taller cards, a filled rack panel behind them -- and that is a design pass, not a capture setting. NOT DONE IN THIS PASS: doing it badly to make a number go green is the failure this artifact is about.
dna.colour_finding: The greyscale verdict is the wrong lens here anyway. blank vs oracle measures focus 4.43% and COLOUR 81.94% -- unlit near-black cards against emissive gold is almost pure hue at similar luminance. The critic's own colour-only rescue caught it. `local` understates this axis.
dna.fixture_why: rotor_frozen pins the `spin` rotor. It is the only nondeterministic value in the file: _process advances the hub at 2.2 rad/s from _ready, so the blade angle at the shutter is a function of how many frames the headless boot managed, and two captures of `spin` were not comparable to each other. The flag is DELIBERATELY UNTYPED because the sweep applies fixtures with Object.set() before _ready and a typed bool silently rejects the string 'true' -- the flag never arrives, the rotor keeps turning, and the sheet reports the clock as an axis. No map passes rotor_frozen, so nothing placed is affected.
dna.still_note: The axis lives entirely in the RIGHT-HAND COLUMN of the head panel -- roughly 0.30 x 0.55 m of a 0.72 x 1.25 m body. The console, slot, RICE 1953 screen and the whole SYNTAX rack are invariant by design, because the claim is that the booth is in perfect working order under all five values. So a low frame percentage here is dilution and not an inert axis, and the first sweep measured exactly that: frame 1.29% against focus 17.25%, which the critic correctly called LOCAL rather than weak.
dna.expected: A PREDICTION, so the re-sweep falsifies it. At framing 0.55 the frame edge is 1.58 m against 2.87 m, an area ratio of 3.3x, so expect frame to land near 4.0-4.5% and the verdict to move from local to bites. Focus should stay near 17% -- focus is already measured in the hot region and reframing does not change what happens there. IF frame COMES BACK UNDER 2%, do not touch the design: check that dna.framing reached the rig at all, because a framing key that never arrives and an axis that does nothing produce the same sheet.
dna.colour_note: blank vs oracle measured focus 4.51% and COLOUR 80.80% on the first sweep -- the largest colour-only rescue in the batch. Unlit near-black cards against emissive gold is almost pure hue at similar luminance, which is precisely the pair a greyscale verdict would have called twins.

rice_verifier_booth.name: Rice Verifier Booth
rice_verifier_booth.description: A verification booth that answers every question about a program's form and cannot answer any question about its meaning

print_gallery_recursion.name: Print Gallery — The Signed Blank
print_gallery_recursion.description: A framed picture on a low plinth whose subject is the gallery it stands in: a plaster wall, a gilt frame hanging on that wall, and inside that frame the same wall again, four levels deep, each turned thirty degrees further and shrunk to 0.55 as it recedes. Built from real geometry and not from a texture - every level is a rectangular annulus, and a twisted band of wall carries the eye from one opening to the next, so the recursion is legible from the front in a single still and comes apart if you stand to the side. At the dead centre, where the levels would have to meet and cannot, a chased silver seal sits proud of the board: a turned bead, twenty-four radial flutes, and a raised square spiral of five bars turning inward and stopping. Under the seal the board is not painted dark - the aperture is open geometry, and the colliders are the plinth, the case shell, its gilt lip and the seal but never the opening, so a hand or a pointer entering the hole meets nothing and a visitor with an eye to it looks through the artwork into whatever the hall put behind it. Escher left the centre of Print Gallery (1956) blank and covered it with his monogram; Lenstra and de Smit reconstructed it at Leiden in 2003, and he never could. The argument is that the gap is not hidden but SIGNED, and that an artist putting his name over the place his construction fails is a more honest account of incompleteness than any statement of it.

measurements.source: COMPUTED, not measured. Derived from the shipped defaults - plinth 1.42 x 0.62 x 0.51, case 1.35 x 1.05 x 0.37 standing on it - because the engine was not available to the session that built it. Re-measure with probe_aabb_hogs before quoting.

dev_themes: the gap that is signed rather than hidden
a construction that cannot close itself
self-reference you can put your eye to
print_gallery_recursion.qfep_connection: foundationscrisis holds that every formal system has an outside and complete order is impossible. Its siblings state that; this one fails to draw it and signs the failure. The hole is real geometry rather than dark paint, so the claim survives a laser, a hand and a walk round the side - and the seal over it is the artifact's actual subject, because incompleteness that has been noticed, named and covered by its own author is a different fact from incompleteness that was merely true.
print_gallery_recursion.note: Built 2026-09-09. WALL_BACKING IS FALSE ON PURPOSE and placement is doing half the argument: a blank wall behind this reads as a plugged hole and says nothing, a doorway or a lit depth behind reads as an outside and says everything. Config keys, all four safe under the grid's shorthand rule: #lid:closed|open|gone - #spiral:wide|escher|none - #rings:2..6 (also #count:) for the level count - #scale:0.2..4 (also #size:). Do NOT write #levels:<n> in a map: 'levels' is not in CONFIG_PARAM_NAMES, so the grid reads the number as tutorial shorthand and sets this node's yaw instead. #spiral:escher is the print's own ratio (x4 per quarter turn, x256 per full turn) and is not the default: at shrink 0.25 the fourth aperture would be 4.7 mm, under the build's 12 mm floor, so escher TRUNCATES TO THREE LEVELS with an 18.8 mm aperture and a 25 mm seal - the ratio runs out of picture before it runs out of levels, which is the difficulty Escher was actually in. #lid:open does not hinge the seal, it SETS IT ASIDE on the outermost wall band: the seal is 147 mm across and its own bay is 200 x 150 x 90 mm, so a swung disc reaches past the next frame's plane at every angle from -75 to -118 degrees and its 73.4 mm half-height clips that frame's 63.9 mm optical half-height. Measured in Python before the build, not found in a render. All the figures in this note are arithmetic. Reviewed 2026-09-09, two faults repaired in the .gd and nothing else touched: (1) the gilt lip stood 55 mm proud of the case mouth with NO collision shape at all - the frontmost, most touchable band on the object, running from y 0.670 to 1.620 - and now carries four box shapes matching its four bars, which leaves the aperture as open as it was; (2) apply_grid_config accepted a BOOL for rings/count/levels/scale/size, so a map writing #levels:4 (the shorthand trap the note above warns about) delivered `true`, int(true) = 1, clamped to 2, and built a TWO-level picture while the map file still read 4 - bools are now refused and the default stands. Still uncompiled and unrendered. No dna.axes block: the axes here are honest but unswept, and a hand-typed declaration that has never met a bite critic is the fault this project most often catches in itself.

dna.measured: PREDICTION FALSIFIED. Predicted 4.5-5.0% at framing 0.55; actual 1.80-1.87% against 1.49% before. framing applied and is verified: subject width went 39% -> 64% of frame. THE ARITHMETIC OF WHY IT COULD NOT WORK: the right plate is 0.44 m of a 1.30 m span, so at framing 0.55 it occupies 21.8% of frame width, or 4.73% of frame area IF FULLY CHANGED. Measured 1.80% means barely a third of the plate actually differs between values -- because the plate itself is identical from value to value and only the TEXT on it changes. Text is thin ink, and 3.3x of very thin ink is still very thin ink. RUN-TO-RUN NOISE MEASURED AT +/-15%: two identical sweeps of unchanged code and registry gave rice_verifier_booth 1.32% then 1.11%, and critic_regress_stack 5.07% then 4.35%. The sweep is not deterministic, so any single-run verdict within about 15% of the 3% threshold is a coin toss reported as a fact. Numbers below are the range across both runs, not a point.
dna.remedy: Ink, not framing. `smooth` vs `twice` differ by one white plate carrying different words; the values that add real area -- `spread` (seven plates) and `lattice` (a 35-cell grid) -- are the ones pulling the mean up at all. The honest repair is to give the divergence itself a body: a filled contrast panel behind the disagreeing lines rather than a 7 mm underline. NOT DONE IN THIS PASS.
dna.still_note: The LEFT plate is invariant on purpose -- it is the product as shipped, and the artifact's argument depends on it not changing. So the axis can only ever move the right half: about 0.44 x 0.26 m of a 1.30 m span, plus whatever apparatus the value adds behind it. First sweep: frame 1.49%, focus 21.50%, verdict LOCAL. The `spread` and `lattice` values add the most ink and should be the strongest pairs; `smooth` against `twice` is the thinnest, and that thinness is the price of `smooth` being an honest picture of the shipped condition.
dna.expected: At framing 0.55 the frame edge is 1.82 m against 3.31 m, 3.3x in area, so expect frame near 4.5-5.0% and a move to bites. The 1.30 m base still sits at 71% of the edge, so no crop.

planar_lift.name: Planar Lift
planar_lift.description: A graph on a table. Flat, its edges collide where they must cross, drawn red; lifted, the edges arc into the third dimension and every collision dissolves while the crossings in the plane stay exactly where they were. Two numbers are computed from the geometry on display and printed together, because the gap between them is the artifact: crossings in the plane (pairs of chords whose shadows intersect - the lift never changes this) and collisions in space (non-adjacent tubes that actually touch, by exact segment-to-segment distance; point sampling was tried first and read two intersecting chords as 10 mm apart). Measured: k5 flat has exactly 5 crossings and 5 collisions, k33 flat exactly 9 and 9, and lifted both drop to 0 collisions with real clearance while the plane's count stands. wheel is the control - planar, zero crossings even flat, so the red marks are facts about k5 and not about flatness. What the artifact shows is this drawing; what Kuratowski's theorem adds is that for k5 and k33 no flat drawing avoids it - these two are the obstructions all non-planarity reduces to. The lift that works is found, not asserted: arc peaks start on a ladder and a capped resolve pass raises touching pairs until space is clear, never at lift=flat, where the plane keeps its verdict. Palle's reading of the source figure: 2d forced into 3d. Readable in code via crossings_in_plane(), collisions_in_space(), min_clearance_m().

predicted_degeneracy.basis: LOWER BOUND, as every prediction in this corpus has been, by 1.5x to 6.7x. The wheel is planar, so nothing changes colour at any lift - the only difference between flat and slight is twelve edges bowing up by at most 2 cm on a piece that is maybe 30 percent of frame, seen from a high oblique angle that forestshortens vertical arcs. Arc displacement is perhaps 5 percent of the subject's projected area. FRAME = 0.30 * 0.05 = 1.5 percent.
predicted_degeneracy.what_to_do_if_it_measures_lower: STOP AND TEST THE HARNESS. Below about 1.5 percent the likely causes in order are (a) the resolve pass having raised slight's arcs at some OTHER graph value but the fixture pinning wheel, where it never fires - check which graph the sweep actually set; (b) the camera standpoint looking straight down, where a vertical arc moves pixels the least - an anamorphic case, run probe_anamorphic before any verdict; (c) a lift value the LIFTS dictionary does not carry, failing silently to flat. Open the PNGs.
predicted_degeneracy.structural_degeneracy_predicted: SAID BEFORE THE SWEEP, fifth artifact running. Expect lift to be CONDITIONAL on graph exactly as leak was on shell and flesh was on waist: at graph=wheel and graph=chain there are no crossings, so no red anywhere and the four lift values differ only by geometry, while at k5 and k33 the flat value stands alone in red and the axis carries colour, number and shape at once. The mean over the cross product will understate the axis; read the per-pair rows grouped by graph. Expect graph to bite hugely everywhere - different node counts, different silhouettes - and expect the plate TEXT to change at every cell, which is honest here because the numbers it prints are measured, not captions.

intractable_evidence.name: The Evidence Term
intractable_evidence.description: Bayes' rule stood up as an object on a pale plinth against a dark panel, with the half that costs nothing lit and the half that cannot be run running off to the right. Reads left to right: a grey posterior plate, an equals, then a blue numerator over a bar, and under the bar the denominator drawn as one tile per term. Each tile and each gap is 0.93 of the last, so the sum converges to a limit point at the panel's right edge that it never reaches, while the counter beside it says 2^N. Zeno's picture doing duty for a sum nobody can finish. The colour rule is the argument: blue produced, grey claimed, amber answered-by-other-means.
intractable_evidence.gamwell_reference: Chapters 9-13: the constructive objection, carried into computation
intractable_evidence.qfep_connection: F is minimised by inference, and exact inference is intractable, so every deployed system sits on an approximation and calls it the answer. The gap between the written posterior and the produced one is where lambda*E(S) is silently discarded rather than held. The amber value is worn bias; the blue one is the case that never occurs.
interactions: static display; walk the length of the denominator and read the counter at the near end

parameters.regime: State of the sum: closed | strained | open | approximated (default open)
parameters.hypothesis_bits: Exponent N in the printed target 2^N (default 12)

intractable_evidence.capacity: SEE a correct formula that cannot be evaluated

dna.measured: PREDICTION NAMED THE RIGHT PAIR AND WAS 4x HIGH ON THE NUMBER, and the predicted_degeneracy block is left exactly as written before any capture. Predicted: strained|open closest, 3.2 percent of frame. Measured: strained|open at 0.790 percent, decisively the twin, since the next closest pair is closed|strained at 2.147, 2.7x higher. Axis peak 3.238 (open|approximated), subject 48.98 percent of frame, verdict BITES. THE INVESTIGATION THE UNDER-SHOOT FORCED IS THE WHOLE VALUE OF THE PASS. The first sweep came back at peak 0.96 with the subject at 13.55 percent and the verdict faint, which reads exactly like an honest axis on a small subject. It was not. dna.framing was dropped 0.9 to 0.48 on the fit-by-diagonal theory and moved the frame number by 0.08 points, that is, nothing. The real fault was tonal: plinth 0.185, mount 0.30 and panel 0.115 sat inside one narrow dark band, so the subject detector, which counts pixels differing from the corner background, could only see the lit plates and the text and scored a 2.5 m panel it was looking straight at as 13.55 percent of frame. Rebalancing to three steps (stone plinth 0.335, machined edges 0.56, panel 0.155) took subject to 48.98 and peak to 3.238 with NO change to the axis, the geometry or any value. The object had not been failing to vary, it had been failing to have a body, and the same fault was making every museum capture of it look like a grey slab. framing is left at 0.48 because that is where the numbers were taken, not because it earned anything. THE REMAINING 4x IS TWO THINGS AND NEITHER IS THE ARTIFACT. First, the critic rescues strained|open from a twin verdict as COLOUR-ONLY: focus 5.26 in luminance against 8.57 per channel, because produced-blue and claimed-grey differ mostly in hue at close brightness, and the prediction's arithmetic implicitly assumed full-contrast ink. Second, the row was assumed to project at 45 percent of its face area, which was generous. STANDING VERDICT local: frame 1.01, focus 19.74. Decisive inside the subject, diluted by the studio's wide frame. strained and open SHOULD be the close pair, since a partial sum and an unstarted one are both no answer, so a twin there is the semantics working and not the axis failing.
dna.default: regime=open. The row recedes with no last tile, every tile in the claimed grey, the posterior plate grey and unlit, and the counter's target is 2^N rather than a number. This is the shipped picture because it is the claim: the denominator is written and never evaluated.
dna.note: regime is the state of the sum over hypotheses. closed draws eight tiles, all produced, with an end-cap, and lights the posterior: the textbook case, which is the case that does not occur outside a textbook. strained draws twenty-six with the near five produced and the rest claimed, and leaves the posterior grey, because a partial sum is not an answer. open draws forty, none produced, no end. approximated deletes the row and keeps six tiles at the depths they held in it, pulled off the axis into amber, and lights the posterior amber: an answer was produced and it is not the one written above. Blue is constructive_proof's witness colour and grey is its unproduced colour, taken deliberately so the two artifacts in this room make one claim in one palette. Amber belongs to nothing else in the room, because the approximated case deserves its own word and must not be allowed to borrow the blue.

predicted_degeneracy.arithmetic: strained and open are the only two values that agree on the posterior plate (grey, unlit), on having no end-cap, and on drawing an unbroken row, so everything separating them is in the tiles and the text. Tile face area goes as 1.55*w^2 with w_i = 0.0943*0.93^i, so the row's total face area is 1.55*0.008892*sum(0.8649^i, i=0..39) = 0.1017 m^2. The five near tiles that strained produces in blue and open leaves grey carry sum(0.8649^i, i=0..4) = 3.818 of that series, which is 0.0526 m^2, or 51.8 percent of the row. The fourteen far tiles that open draws and strained does not carry only 0.1479 of the series, 0.0020 m^2, or 2.0 percent, so the length difference is nearly invisible and the colour difference is nearly everything. Seen obliquely the row projects at roughly 45 percent of its face area, giving about 0.024 m^2 of changed ink against a subject projecting about 0.45 m^2; at an expected subject share near 55 percent of frame that is 2.9 percent, plus roughly 0.3 percent for the counter and caption lines. NOT YET MEASURED: no sweep has been run on this token. Per the corpus rule the prediction is a floor, not a forecast, and every prediction on record has under-predicted by 1.5x to 6.7x; a sweep coming back BELOW 3.2 percent means something is broken, not that the axis is quiet.

dna.default: specimen=built - the exact shipped picture. _build_solid() is _create_visual()'s old inline block moved into a function and nothing else: one BoxMesh at Vector3(0.3, 0.3, 0.3), one StandardMaterial3D at albedo (0.3, 0.6, 0.9), at the artifact's origin. It now hangs under a Specimen Node3D that sits at the origin with an identity transform, so the world position of the cube is unchanged; the arrow keeps the string '← Must BUILD it' character for character and the caption is identical at every value. All three placements (Brouwer_Intuitionism as a bare token, the curation_station collection in Curation_Bay_foundationscrisis_2, and exhibit_furniture#mount:constructive_proof in the six Trial_* museums) pass no key this reads - exhibit_furniture instantiates the mounted scene and forwards nothing - so nothing standing changes.
dna.was: no declared axis, and the runner refused the token for NO TURNABLE KNOBS: there were no @export lines at all. apply_grid_config accepted `color` and `size`, which are a tint and a dimension. The artifact's own critical_parameter is 'the witness - without an explicit construction, the proof is rejected', and the witness was a hard-coded 0.3 m cube that was always present, so the classical proof its caption names was the one thing the room could never be shown.
dna.note: specimen is what the proof puts forward in the place where x must be. built = the solid cube, blue, constructive: here is x. outline = the same cube as twelve edge bars in grey, the claim keeping its shape with nothing inside it. candidates = twenty-seven small grey cubes filling the same 0.3 m volume with none of them distinguished, existence over a finite domain where the proof will not say which. absent = a thin grey plate whose top face sits exactly where the solid cube's underside was and nothing above it, the reductio that refutes non-existence and produces nothing. Blue means produced and grey means claimed, which is the whole argument in one colour rule. Every value builds real MeshInstance3D geometry in the same slot, including absent - a value that measured zero AABB would be a fact about the capture rather than about the proof. The caption is deliberately NOT switched: it states both positions and stays true at every value, so a measured bite is a bite in the object. The arrow line does switch, because '← Must BUILD it' standing beside an empty plate is the label contradicting the picture.
dna.kin: `evidence` (result|trace|longhand|axiom, 19 declarations) was considered and DECLINED. It is the corpus's word for how much of the working is admitted alongside the result, and its rungs are a monotone disclosure ladder over an apparatus in motion. There is no working here and nothing in motion - one static claim - and the values are not more-or-less of one thing: candidates is not 'more working than outline', it is a different proof. Taking the word with a different question is the failure check_dna_declarations exists to catch. `witness` is the term of art and this artifact's own vocabulary, and was ALSO declined: lab_room already declares witness = pane|none|port|sash for an observation aperture, and one word covering two unrelated questions makes a shared vocabulary a lie. specimen is a new word and shares nothing; the nearest live neighbour is godel_statement_plaque.outside (quotation|margin|breach|omission|habitat), which asks where a statement stands relative to a system rather than what a proof produces.

constructive_proof.description: A static specimen illustrates a witness: constructive existence requires supplying x and establishing P(x). The cube does not prove an arbitrary proposition.
constructive_proof.qfep_connection: Ask what has been supplied and what property has actually been established.
interactions: Observe the specimen and compare it with an explicit witness in the choice sequence or diagonal workbench.

dna.default: regime=all, trace=attractor - all is the one value absent from REGIME_WINDOWS, and _apply_regime returns immediately on it, so r_min=2.5 and r_max=4.0 stay exactly as exported and the whole diagram is framed as it always was; attractor is the `_:` branch of _keeps_iteration, which is the shipped `j >= skip_transient` test. apply_grid_config rebuilds only when a value it recognises actually differs AND _ready has already built once, so the 8 cells across four maps (Crisis_Synthesis, Crisis_Synthesis_composed, Corridor_Crisis_Synthesis, Trial_eye_Crisis_Synthesis) rebuild nothing and render the same picture. One deliberate difference: the z scatter was an unseeded randf_range, so every launch was a different cloud; it is now the same range from a seeded RNG. The jitter is +/-0.025 m of depth on a 4 x 2 m plot, invisible in a still, and without it no two frames of a sweep would be comparable.
dna.was: r_min=2.5 and r_max=4.0 were @export but nothing read them from a map, so every placement showed the same full sweep; skip_transient=50 silently threw the first fifty iterations away with no way to ask for them. The artifact's whole argument - that r selects a qualitative regime - was the one thing a map could not say.
dna.note: regime crops the r axis onto one claim about the same map, because WHICH WINDOW you are shown is the argument. stable = 2.5..3.0, one line, no branching, the map before it has anything to say; cascade = 3.0..3.57, the period-doubling ladder where Feigenbaum's constant is legible as the shrinking of each rung; chaos = 3.57..4.0, the band, plus the period-3 window sitting inside it as a stripe of order; period3 = 3.82..3.87, that window filling the whole plot, where the eye finds three clean branches inside what was called chaos - the strongest thing the diagram can say. trace is which part of each orbit counts as the picture: attractor draws only where the orbit ended up (the shipped diagram), transient draws every iteration including the run-in (the tree with a haze over it - the arriving), approach draws ONLY the fifty discarded iterations and no tree at all, which is the diagram's own waste product held up as the image.
dna.kin: regime is the family word (harmonic_motion_demo, spring_demo, mass_spring_damper, VectorForces, homogeneous_coordinates, DualBallFMController) and it is used for exactly the family's question - which qualitative behaviour class is on show. The `all` value is taken from mass_spring_damper character for character, and means the same thing there and here: do not crop, this is the shipped uncropped view. The other four values cannot be shared, because a damping ladder and a logistic cascade have different classes - underdamped is not a thing the logistic map can be - and inventing a mapping between them would make an incomparable family look comparable. trace is the LOOSE family word (spring_demo: off/phase/wave; fourier_transform: samples/stems/ribbon) meaning which drawing of the data is shown, and it is taken in that loose sense. It is deliberately NOT `evidence`, whose ladder (result/trace/longhand/axiom) is fixed character for character across fourteen artifacts and means how much of the working is admitted alongside the result: approach withholds the result and shows only the working, which is the inverse of the last rung of that ladder and would corrupt the word.
dna.still_note: regime is a strong axis in pixels - the four crops share almost no ink, since the point cloud is redrawn over a different domain and _get_color_for_r re-ramps across it. trace is strong at approach (the tree vanishes; only the run-in haze remains) and thinner at transient, where the haze is added over an unchanged tree; the added points are 50 of every 100 iterations though, so it should still clear the 3% line. The MultiMesh caveat applies: the capture AABB counts MeshInstance3D only and every point here lives in a MultiMeshInstance3D, so the only mesh instances are the two thin axis bars and the highlight plane - check the framing before believing any subject-percentage figure.

bifurcation_diagram.qfep_connection: Compare an explicit recurrence with the research formula. The logistic map does not establish a universal optimal lambda, a moral preference for chaos or a QFEP theorem.
interactions: Move r independently of the QFEP sliders. Compare 2.9, 3.2, 3.5 and 3.83; examine what the sample retains.

dna.default: macrostate=uniform, chance=all - uniform is the `_:` branch of _region_plan() and returns the one shipped region lo=(-r, 0, -r) hi=(r, r, r), so the three randf_range calls draw from the same ranges in the same order; chance=all draws size, hue and spin exactly as before; and the wire bounds frame is built ONLY when macrostate != uniform, so the default adds no node. All three placements (QFEP_E_Term, Corridor_QFEP_E_Term, Curation_Bay_qfeplaboratory_4) are bare tokens, and apply_grid_config returns before rebuilding unless a key is present AND its value differs AND _ready has already built. THE PILE WAS NEVER THE SAME TWICE: the artifact is unseeded by design, so `exact' here means the same code path and the same distribution, which is the strongest sense available. chance_seed defaults to 0, which keeps the global RNG - only the sweep's fixture pins it.
dna.was: six exports and no apply_grid_config, so nothing was reachable from a map token. Every export was a dimension, a rate or a colour: cube_count, spawn_radius, size_min, size_max, drift_speed, base_color. The two decisions that carry the argument - WHICH region the cubes occupy and WHAT is left to the dice - were written inline in the spawn loop.
dna.note: hand promotion 2026-08-04, refused by the runner as NO TURNABLE KNOBS. BOTH WORDS ARE BORROWED, neither invented. macrostate = uniform|corner|layered|spilled is microstate_counter's axis, character for character - the artifact in this same sequence whose entire job is to print log10(W) for exactly these four arrangements. Entropy is not a property of a pile, it is a count of the ways the pile could have been, and that count does not exist until you say which macrostate you are counting: the same twenty cubes crowded into one octant are just as randomly placed and have vastly fewer ways to be. chance = none|hue|size|all is john_cage_tech_noir's, and this artifact ships the opposite end of it - that piece surrenders NOTHING visible to chance and defaults to `none`; this one defaults to `all`. One borrowed question, two artifacts standing at its two ends, which is worth more than a private word at each.
dna.orientation_caveat: ORIENTATION RIDES WITH `all`. The borrowed chance list has no value for spin, and forking the list to add one would make the shared word a lie, so none/hue/size all stand their cubes axis-aligned and only `all` tumbles them. Stated because it is the single place the borrowed vocabulary does not cover this artifact exactly. Their angular velocity is zeroed too, not just their initial rotation: a value has to survive being stood in for ten minutes, not only photographed - a random spin would have eroded `aligned' within seconds.
dna.frame_note: THE WIRE BOX IS PART OF THE ARGUMENT AND ONLY THE NON-DEFAULT VALUES GET IT. The spawn volume is invisible in the shipped artifact, so `corner` without a frame is not the same pile confined but simply a smaller pile over there - which is size wearing a name - and `spilled` would have nothing to have spilled out of. microstate_counter draws its amber octant cage for the same stated reason. uniform draws no frame and is therefore untouched.
dna.declined: drift_speed, this file's own declared critical_parameter. At zero the chaos is frozen and above zero it is visibly restless - real, and invisible to a still PNG. info_board was swept across five duration exports and published six identical tiles. Rates stay exports.
dna.fixture_note: WITHOUT chance_seed THE SWEEP MEASURES A DIFFERENT OBJECT PER FRAME. Every position, size, hue and velocity comes from an unseeded global randf, so four values of an axis would be four fresh piles and any difference measured would be the dice, not the axis. chance_seed pins the draw; it defaults to 0, which is the shipped unseeded path, so no placement is affected.
dna.measurement_risk: SPARSE SUBJECT. Twenty cubes of 0.05-0.15 m loose in a 2 x 1 x 2 m volume: the union AABB the sweep frames on is mostly empty air, so a faint verdict here should be crop-rechecked before it is believed (random_walk_collection moved 174 grey levels across 0.06% of frame and read the same as a genuinely inert axis). The wire frame on three of the four macrostate values helps - it puts a fixed, high-contrast reference in the same pixels. `spilled' was deliberately kept close (plume to 1.45r, not 3r) so the union does not shrink the other three values to specks.

random_cubes.qfep_connection: Cubes in chaotic disarray — high entropy as furniture, random positions and rotations and scales. The grid's own elements thrown to the λ=1 wind, order's vocabulary spoken as noise. Between this and the ordered_grid the whole spectrum stretches.

particle_chaos.name: Particle Chaos
particle_chaos.description: High-entropy particle system. Maximum spread, random velocities, dissolution.
particle_chaos.qfep_connection: A high-entropy particle system at maximum spread — random velocities, no structure, the λ=1 extreme where possibility has swallowed pattern whole. Freedom without form: the chapter's demonstration that too much entropy is as dead as too little.

qfep_chalkboard.description: A wide chalkboard for the QUEER FREE ENERGY PRINCIPLE - QFE = F - lambda E(S) + phi dE beside an edge-of-chaos curve peaking at lambda~0.4 where life sits between order and noise.
qfep_chalkboard.name: QFEP Chalkboard
qfep_chalkboard.qfep_connection: This IS the QFEP, stated. Life at the edge, not frozen and not noise. The phi-term is the queer one - refusing to settle.

crystal_formation.name: Crystal Formation
crystal_formation.description: Ordered crystal cluster for λ=0 zone. Pure order, frozen pattern.
crystal_formation.qfep_connection: The λ=0 zone as a grown crystal — order so complete nothing can move. It states the equation's left boundary: maximal free energy, minimal entropy, a pattern that will never surprise you again. The chapter needs it visible so the aliveness of the middle can be felt as a departure from it.

edge_particles.name: Edge Particles
edge_particles.description: Particles at the edge of chaos (λ≈0.4). Dancing, self-organizing, alive.
edge_particles.qfep_connection: Particles at λ≈0.4 — dancing, self-organizing, alive. Not frozen like the crystal, not scattered like the chaos, but caught in the narrow band where order and freedom negotiate continuously. This is what the equation predicts life looks like: perpetual motion that neither settles nor flies apart.

ordered_grid.name: Ordered Grid
ordered_grid.description: Perfectly aligned cube grid representing low λ. Order, predictability, rigidity.
ordered_grid.qfep_connection: A perfectly aligned cube grid — low λ as architecture. Predictability, rigidity, every cell where you expect it: the comfort and the tomb of pure order. The curriculum's own grid, pushed to the λ=0 extreme where structure becomes a cage.

chaos_particles.name: Chaos Particles
chaos_particles.description: λ=1 dissolution zone. Particles exploding outward, no coherence, pure entropy.
chaos_particles.qfep_connection: λ=1: the dissolution zone, particles exploding outward with no coherence, pure entropy. The hot end of the spectrum where E(S) has won and F cannot hold anything together — total freedom, total meaninglessness. The pole opposite the crystal, and equally uninhabitable.

lambda_hall.name: Lambda Hall
lambda_hall.description: A full-size authored spectrum between regular and dispersed forms. Optional recommendation_control adds an entrance rail that moves only the lit floor strip and inscriptions; the rows, their colours and animation are independent of that suggestion.
lambda_hall.qfep_connection: Who sets the relative weight, and who can revise its spatial recommendation? The green band is an authored preference, not a measured condition for life.

parameters.recommendation_control: on/off; default off. Adds LIT STRIP and RETURN.
parameters.recommendation_position: 0.20–0.80; movable floor recommendation independent of lambda_value.
parameters.lambda_value: Authored structure/colour preference; controls the original geometry at build time.

phase_cube.name: Phase Cube
phase_cube.description: A cube that shows phase transitions. SOLID (crystal, λ<0.25) → COMPLEX (edge, 0.25<λ<0.55) → GAS (dissolution, λ>0.55). Visual metaphor for matter states as QFEP states.
phase_cube.qfep_connection: Matter's phase diagram hijacked as pedagogy: two thresholds (λ 0.25 and 0.55) cut a continuum into solid, complex, gas, while a dissolution scalar does the actual becoming between the labels. The cube stays a cube throughout — it is the category that melts.

dna.default: regime=all, occupancy=corridor - all is the one value absent from REGIME_WINDOWS and _apply_regime returns on it immediately, so r_min=2.5 and r_max=4.0 stay exactly as exported, all three regime markers stay inside the corridor and nothing is skipped by the new range guard. corridor is the `_:` branch of _dot_position and is the shipped expression character for character: y = x * (wall_height - 0.5) + 0.25, z scattered across +/- 0.6 * walkway_width. apply_grid_config is guarded three ways (key present, value buildable, value different) and returns before _rebuild_data until _built is true, so the 2 placements - QFEP_Lambda_Spectrum (token bifurcation_walkway:90:0:0.8) and Corridor_QFEP_Lambda_Spectrum - rebuild nothing. ONE DELIBERATE DIFFERENCE, the same one bifurcation_diagram took on 2026-08-03: the z scatter was a bare randf(), so every launch was a different cloud. It is now the identical range from a generator seeded 20260803. Statistically the same corridor, but comparable frame to frame, and without it a sweep of occupancy would be measuring the RNG.
dna.was: No axis exports at all - refused by the runner for NO TURNABLE KNOBS. walkway_length, r_min, r_max, num_columns and dot_size were @export but they are dimensions and resolution, not claims: no map could say anything about WHAT the corridor argues. The r window and the cloud's place in the architecture were both single hard-coded facts.
dna.note: regime crops the r axis onto one behaviour class, and the crop means something different in a corridor than in a chart. A cropped chart is a chart of less; a cropped corridor is twelve metres of one condition. stable = 2.5..3.0 is a corridor you can walk end to end while nothing whatever happens - the transition promised by the title refused, which is the sharpest sentence this artifact has. cascade = 3.0..3.57 puts the whole period-doubling ladder under a twelve-metre walk, so Feigenbaum's constant is legible as the rungs crowding toward the far end. chaos = 3.57..4.0 is the band with the period-3 window standing in it as a stripe of order. period3 = 3.82..3.87 fills the corridor with that window alone, three clean branches inside what the signage calls chaos. occupancy asks where the mathematics meets the body, which is this artifact's whole thesis and the one thing it could not vary: corridor suspends the cloud at head height so you walk THROUGH it and displace it; mural flattens it onto the two side walls and hands you back the chart you were supposed to have escaped, walking past rather than through; inlay drops it into the floor and maps the population value ACROSS the corridor instead of up it, so the cascade branches left and right beneath you and the part you stand on is the part you cannot see; vault lifts it overhead out of reach. Each is a different relation between a body and a parameter, not a different mounting.
dna.kin: regime is bifurcation_diagram's word, taken character for character - the same five values, the same four windows, the same meaning of `all`. That reuse is deliberate and checkable: this artifact and that one are the SAME equation drawn twice, once as a chart on a wall and once as architecture you walk, so if the shared word is honest the two should measure alike under it. Any large divergence in the bite numbers is a finding about the difference between reading a diagram and standing in one. regime is also the wider family word (harmonic_motion_demo, spring_demo, mass_spring_damper, VectorForces, homogeneous_coordinates, DualBallFMController) used for exactly the family's question. The sibling's SECOND axis, trace = attractor|transient|approach, was deliberately NOT taken: skip_transient is right there and it would have transferred mechanically, but it is the chart's question - which drawing of the data is shown - and repeating it here would have produced a second artifact that argues nothing a corridor argues. occupancy is a new word. The nearest existing ones were rejected on meaning: support (none|stand|frame|pylon) and admission (none|bench|residue|exhibit) are furniture words about how a prop is held, and reading this axis as mounting is precisely the error - a walkway's whole claim is embodiment, so where the data sits relative to the walking body IS its argument.
dna.still_note: occupancy should bite hardest - the point cloud is most of the ink and mural, inlay and vault each move all of it into a different half of the frame. regime is strong for the same reason bifurcation_diagram's is: the cloud is redrawn over a different domain and _get_color_for_r re-ramps across it, so the four crops share almost no ink. THE MULTIMESH CAVEAT APPLIES AND IS SEVERE HERE: every dot lives in a MultiMeshInstance3D, which the capture AABB does not count, so the measured extent comes only from the floor slab, the two wall planes, the 24 floor-gradient segments and the three marker bars. Those are the corridor SHELL and they do not move under either axis, so a subject-percentage computed from them will understate the change. The one place that was fatal rather than merely pessimistic is occupancy=vault, where the cloud is lifted to wall_height + 1.55, above every mesh instance in the scene: an unfixed capture would have framed the empty corridor and scored the axis as `the dots were deleted`. _build_frame_anchor adds a layers = 0 box covering the real extent, and ONLY at vault - building it for all four values would inflate the framing of the three that do not need it, which is the same fault reversed.
dna.gotcha: The r readout, the regime name and the floor colour all track a PLAYER who is not present during a headless capture; _process falls back to arrow keys, so a still is always taken at _current_r = r_min with the r and regime labels parked at the corridor entrance. That is time- and input-domain and neither axis touches it - both were chosen to be facts about built geometry, which is there whether or not anyone is walking. Note also that TWO different artifacts are called bifurcation_walkway in this repo: this corridor at commons/interfaces/qfep/, and an unregistered vertical display at commons/artifacts/bifurcation_walkway/ that still carries class_name BifurcationWalkway. Only this one is reachable from a map token; the promotion is on this one.

bifurcation_walkway.name: Bifurcation Walkway
bifurcation_walkway.description: A corridor where your position = r parameter in the logistic map. Walk through the phase transition: stable → period doubling → chaos → windows of order. The bifurcation diagram made walkable.
interactions: walk_through
bifurcation_walkway.qfep_connection: The logistic map's r parameter IS the Î» drive. At râ‰ˆ3.57, chaos begins â€” this is Î»_edge, where life exists. You walk through the phase space of orderâ†’chaos.

dissolving_form.name: Dissolving Form
dissolving_form.description: A mesh that appears to dissolve/disintegrate. High λ territory.
dissolving_form.qfep_connection: A mesh caught mid-disintegration — high-λ territory, form losing its own edges. The visible act of order surrendering to entropy, structure remembered just long enough to be seen dissolving. The equation's right slope made motion.

complexity_pattern.name: Complexity Pattern
complexity_pattern.description: Game of Life cellular automata at edge of chaos. Self-organizing complexity.

dna.default: rule=life, readout=relief - life is [[3], [2, 3]], which is B3/S23, which is the `neighbors == 2 or neighbors == 3` that _step_simulation wrote out by hand; relief keeps the shipped 0.5 x cell_size body and the shipped 1.5 lift on a living cell, and is the only readout that leaves mesh.position alone. Neither key is passed by either of the 2 existing placements, and apply_grid_config rebuilds only when a value both validates and differs, so those two rooms are unchanged.
dna.was: no axis at all - the runner refused this token for NO TURNABLE KNOBS. The five exports are grid_size, cell_size, update_interval and two colours: dimensions and decoration. The two decisions that carry the argument were hard-coded one function down, the transition rule in _step_simulation and the elevation in _update_visuals, and there was no apply_grid_config, so a map token could not reach anything.
dna.note: hand promotion 2026-08-03. The @identity names the critical_parameter as initial density (~0.4), and density is the WRONG knob here on both counts: under Life every starting density converges to the same sparse litter of still lifes within twenty generations, so five densities photograph as five indistinguishable fields - the reaction_diffusion failure exactly. The quantity that actually carries lambda is a property of the RULE TABLE, not of the soup. So the axis is the law: life sits at the edge, seeds sprays, replicator fills with periodic fractal texture, maze and coral freeze into standing structure. The artifact stops asserting 'edge of chaos' and starts showing what the two sides of it look like. NOT named `generator` although perlin_noise declares that word for the same slot - a noise basis is sampled once and has no history, these are transition rules whose whole content is what they do to their own output over time.
dna.shares_vocabulary_with: perlin_noise, simplex_noise, mandelbrot_set, perlin_noise_terrain, random_edge_profile - readout is relief|plate|column on all of them, same three words, same meaning, and relief is the default on all of them because each shipped code path lifts its sample. This field can therefore be compared with those five rather than merely contrasted.
dna.fixture_note: the field is GENERATIVE and slow. pattern_seed pins the soup, without which six rule variants are six different random starts and the sweep measures the RNG instead of the law. warmup runs 80 generations before the first frame, without which every variant photographs the same undifferentiated 40% soup - no rule has spoken yet at generation 0. Both default to 0 in code, which is the shipped behaviour (fresh randomness, player meets the soup and watches it organise), so they are fixture knobs and not axes.
dna.measurement_risk: the subject is a 0.64 x 0.64 slab about 0.02 thick, so a fit-by-diagonal camera will under-frame it. If the critic reports faint on both axes, check subject % before believing it and add a framing hint rather than re-cutting the axis.

complexity_pattern.qfep_connection: Conway's Game of Life running at the edge of chaos — self-organizing complexity from the simplest rules. The canonical proof that the edge is real: gliders and oscillators and still lifes, none designed, all emergent, the cellular-automata chapter's crown reappearing here as evidence for the equation's central band.

rigid_sculpture.name: Rigid Sculpture
rigid_sculpture.description: Static crystalline form for φ<0 zone. Resists change.

dna.default: formation=ring - ring is the shipped arrangement line for line: the same (i/element_count)*TAU angle, the same size*0.6 radius, the same outward -angle turn, with the central octahedron and both caps untouched. It is also the _: fallthrough, so an unknown word renders the shipped sculpture rather than blanking it. The one existing placement (QFEP_Phi_Term) passes no keys, and apply_grid_config rebuilds only when a value both validates and differs, and only after _ready has built once, so that room is unchanged.
dna.was: one hard-coded ring of eight prisms around an octahedron, with no apply_grid_config at all - so nothing here was reachable from a map token. The three exports were size, element_count and a colour: dimensions and decoration. The decision that carries the argument, WHICH order this monument keeps, was written inline in the build loop under a comment that said perfect geometric arrangement.
dna.note: hand promotion 2026-08-04, refused by the runner as NO TURNABLE KNOBS. The @identity names the critical_parameter as the ABSENCE OF ANIMATION - and that cannot be an axis, because the evidence is one still PNG: a form that does not move and a form that does are the same photograph. So the axis is the other half of the claim. phi<0 does not merely resist change, it defends a particular order, and the five values are five orders worth defending: a centre held on all sides (ring), repetition without privilege (lattice), closure in every direction (shell), rank (column), and an order that has already weathered and holds its pose anyway (drift). drift is seeded per index, because the shipped code contains no randomness at all and an unseeded draw would make five variants of five objects.
dna.shares_vocabulary_with: reactive_particle_field, reactive_particles, edge_particles, emergence_zone (four registry tokens on one scene) and delaunay_triangulation_3d_cell - formation is lattice|shell|ring|column|drift on all of them, same five words, same question: where a set of small elements stands relative to one another. Only the default differs, because this artifact ships the ring and they ship the lattice, so this sculpture can be compared with those five rather than merely contrasted. NOT crystal_cluster's growth (scatter|druse|lattice|vein), which is the nearest artifact in the registry and was hand-promoted for the same reason: growth asks how a mineral GREW and its values are mineralogical events, whereas this is a made monument arguing about imposed order - and its shipped ring is not among growth's four values at all.
dna.measurement_risk: column and shell change the merged AABB (a 0.8 tall stack, a 0.48 sphere) where ring and lattice are flat and wide, so a fit-by-diagonal camera frames them differently. That is honest here - the formation really does change the shape - but do not read the reframing itself as the bite.

rigid_sculpture.qfep_connection: A static crystalline form for the φ<0 zone — not just ordered but *resisting* change, order that has taken a stance against becoming. Where the crystal is merely frozen, this one is frozen on purpose, the conservative signature made sculpture.

fluid_form.name: Fluid Form
fluid_form.description: Morphing iridescent form for φ>0 zone. Embraces becoming.

dna.default: flux=mixed - mixed returns (noise_gain 1.0, sway_gain 0.3), which are the two constants the vertex function carried inline, so the shader computes exactly the code as written. flux needs no rebuild at all - it is two uniforms - and apply_grid_config returns untouched when a config carries none of its keys, which the one existing placement (QFEP_Phi_Term) does not. THE DEFAULT PRESERVES THE CODE PATH BUT NOT WHAT THAT ROOM LOOKED LIKE. See shader_fix; the change was unavoidable and is stated plainly rather than buried.
dna.shader_fix: THE SHADER DID NOT COMPILE, and had not since the file was written. Two fatal errors: fmod is not a function in Godot's shading language (that is GDScript's and HLSL's name for it - the shader language has mod, and fract is what this code wanted), and vec3(127.1, 311.7, 74.7, 1.0) passes four components to a three-component constructor. So the ShaderMaterial never built and the one shipped placement has been rendering an unshaded sphere, not the morphing iridescent form that the registry description, the artifact's name and its @identity block all describe. The hash line is now the one that works in marble_column.gdshader and random_animated.gdshader in this same repo. Fixing it changes that one room, from broken to intended. Leaving it broken was not an option: an axis living in a vertex shader that does not compile produces four identical frames and an INERT verdict that is a fact about the harness rather than about the design - the exact finished-looking experiment that answers nothing.
dna.was: a sphere plus a morphing shader, with no apply_grid_config at all, so nothing here was reachable from a map token - and the shader did not compile in the first place. The four exports were size, morph_speed, flow_intensity and a colour: dimensions, a rate and decoration.
dna.note: hand promotion 2026-08-04, refused by the runner as NO TURNABLE KNOBS. flow_intensity is this file's own declared critical_parameter and it is the WRONG axis: five intensities photograph as five degrees of lumpiness, which is size wearing a name; morph_speed is worse, because a rate is invisible to a still. The vertex function spends its displacement in two registers at a fixed 1.0 : 0.3 ratio - noise ALONG THE NORMAL, where the skin churns and the body keeps its shape, and one smooth wave through the WHOLE BODY, where the silhouette bends. mixed, skin and sway all spend the same flow_intensity and differ only in which register receives it, so the axis is emphatically not an amount. still spends none and is the control: the same form at phi = 0, which is the comparison the phi>0 / phi<0 pair exists to make. NOT named becoming, although queer_morphology_specimen owns that word for phi and sits in this artifact's own cluster_with list - its values (jarred, cracked, escaped, clouded) are about the JAR, the specimen's relation to the vitrine that classifies it, and this form has no jar. Same theme, different question, different word.
dna.fixture_note: freeze_time pins the shader clock and stops the idle rotation so that every flux value is photographed at the same phase - without it the sweep partly measures which frame the camera happened to catch. It defaults to -1.0, which is live time and the shipped behaviour, and is left UNTYPED on purpose, because a typed float rejects the string a fixture passes before _ready. frag_time follows it into the fragment shader and falls through to TIME whenever freeze_time is negative, so the iridescence is untouched unless a capture asks otherwise.
dna.family: NOT one scene under many names, which was the first thing checked. fluid_form, rigid_sculpture and edge_core are three scenes, three scripts and three generators - a shader-morphed sphere; eleven MeshInstance3D built with SurfaceTool and no _process at all; two spheres plus a GPUParticles3D ring - with 4, 3 and 6 exports respectively. The identical-export-count tell is absent. They are a rhetorical pair (phi>0 against phi<0) plus a third object about lambda, and they honestly take three vocabularies. The real one-scene-many-names family sits next door in this registry: reactive_particle_field, reactive_particles, edge_particles and emergence_zone are four tokens on one .tscn.

fluid_form.qfep_connection: A morphing iridescent form for the φ>0 zone — a shape that embraces becoming, never settling, iridescence as the color of change welcomed. The queer signature made beautiful: not resisting time like the rigid sculpture, but flowing with it, difference as the point rather than the threat.

preserved_pattern.name: Preserved Pattern
preserved_pattern.description: Static checkerboard that never changes. Conservative φ<0.

dna.default: motif=checker - checker is the `_:` branch of _is_on() and returns `(x + z) % 2 == 0`, the shipped rule character for character, with the same two materials, the same 0.9/0.3/0.9 cell box and the same cell_size * 0.15 lift on the marked cells. All three placements (QFEP_Phi_Term, Corridor_QFEP_Phi_Term, Curation_Bay_qfeplaboratory_5) are bare tokens; apply_grid_config returns before rebuilding unless a key is present AND differs AND _ready has already built once, and a typo also lands on `_:`, so no room can be blanked by a bad word.
dna.was: three exports - grid_size, cell_size, pattern_color - and no apply_grid_config, so nothing was reachable from a map token. The decision that carries the argument was the literal `(x + z) % 2 == 0` inline in the build loop, under a comment reading Classic checkerboard - stable, predictable, preserved.
dna.note: hand promotion 2026-08-04, refused by the runner as NO TURNABLE KNOBS. The @identity names the critical_parameter as THE ABSENCE OF TIME - there is no _process, no delta, no becoming - and that cannot be an axis, because the evidence is one still PNG and a form that does not move photographs identically to one that does. So the axis is the other half of the claim. The artifact says phi<0 preserves a pattern at the cost of life and then never says WHICH pattern, as though there were only one - which is precisely the move a conservative order makes about its own conventions. The checkerboard is not the pattern; it is one inherited draft among several, frozen. Naming the choice is the promotion, and `blank` is the value that finishes the argument: the grid still perfectly regular, still immortal, with nothing left in it to preserve.
dna.shares_vocabulary_with: pattern_tile_puzzle (and the five sibling tokens on that scene: _4x4, _mirror, _8x8, _brick, _herringbone). `motif` = blank|checker|cross|twill|houndstooth, the same five words for the same question - which figure a square grid of cells carries - and the arithmetic is reproduced cell for cell, so the two artifacts measure ALIKE: checker is (x+z)%2==0, twill is (x+z)%4<2, cross is the centre row and column, houndstooth is the same 4x4 bitmap tiled. Only the DEFAULT differs, because the loom ships `blank` (it arrives empty, waiting to be edited) and this museum piece ships `checker` (the draft it will keep forever) - which is itself the difference between the two artifacts stated in one word. NOT `dyelot`, pattern_tile's second axis: this grid runs on two materials, not eight yarns, so there is nothing to re-dye.
dna.not_shared_with: random_cubes, its opposite number in this same batch, which took `macrostate` (uniform|corner|layered|spilled) from microstate_counter. The two ARE the two ends of one conceptual line - frozen order against high entropy - and putting them on one shared scale was the tempting move. Refused: the values of such a scale would be DEGREES OF NOISE, an amount wearing a name, and neither artifact's own hidden constant is an amount. One is a draft, the other is a region. A pattern has no macrostate and a loose pile has no motif; they are different terms of the formula (phi against E(S)) on different substrates. edge_core refused a shared word across terms yesterday on exactly this reasoning.
dna.measurement_risk: A THIN FLAT PLATE. The grid is 0.36 m across and about 0.03 m tall, so a fit-by-diagonal camera frames 0.51 m and the plate is foreshortened further by the sweep's slight downward angle - the classic wide-flat dilution case. framing 0.85 brings the fit to about 0.43 m, still wider than the 0.36 m plate so no corner is cropped. The axis lives in WHICH cells are lit and raised, which is the whole face of the subject rather than a detail inside it, so the bite should be strong; if it reads faint, crop-recheck before believing the verdict.

preserved_pattern.qfep_connection: A checkerboard that never changes — φ<0 made flat and eternal. Conservation as a value: the pattern that has decided the past was correct and the future is a threat. The equation's other resistance, not to disorder but to time.

transforming_pattern.name: Transforming Pattern
transforming_pattern.description: Constantly evolving wave pattern. Queer φ>0 signature.

dna.default: concert=superposition - the `_:` branch of _combined() is the three inline waves term for term, sin(t + x*0.8 + z*0.3) + cos(t*1.3 + x*0.4 - z*0.7) + sin(t*0.7 - x*0.5 + z*0.9) over 3, so the 1 existing placement moves cell for cell as it always has. phase_lock defaults to -1.0, which is the free-running clock; the fixture pins it only on the bench.
dna.was: One unnamed wave field, three incommensurate sines averaged inline in _process, driving height, scale, hue and spin. No exports reachable from a map token: there was no apply_grid_config at all.

transforming_pattern.qfep_connection: A constantly evolving wave pattern — the φ>0 queer signature in motion. Where the preserved checkerboard freezes, this one refuses to hold still, its identity located in transformation rather than persistence. The equation's third term made visible: what matters here is the rate of change, and this pattern has chosen to change.

lambda_promenade.name: Lambda Promenade
lambda_promenade.description: The eight promoted QFEP bodies as one walkable line: icon-scale emblems in λ order on a 4.34 m rail, each rebuilding its source at that source's own default, with the λ value etched on every plinth and the F and E(S) poles at the ends. A SERIES synthesis.

relationships.finding: Eight QFEP artifacts were promoted separately in one week and four came back with the SAME finding, independently: an object whose whole claim is about a POSITION had only ever been able to draw one position. [[edge_core]] said it plainest — you cannot see that the edge is NARROW if the two things it is narrow between are never in the room — and that sentence is what this artifact is built out of. The promenade is the missing second term made architectural: the neighbours a body is a position RELATIVE TO, standing in the same room, at icon scale, in λ order, on one rail.

sources.preserved_pattern: [[preserved_pattern]] learned that φ<0 does not merely resist change, it defends a PARTICULAR order — the artifact argued that a pattern is preserved and never said which pattern, 'which is exactly the move a conservative order makes about its own conventions'. Exhibited at λ 0.00 as a 6x6 checkerboard built by its own motif=checker rule, (x + z) % 2 == 0, marked cells raised by cell_size * 0.15, in its own two materials.
sources.rigid_sculpture: [[rigid_sculpture]] learned the same thing about a made monument: five formations are five orders worth defending, and 'the absence of animation cannot be an axis, because a form that does not move and a form that does are the same photograph'. Exhibited at λ 0.05 (qfep_reactor's ORDER_LAMBDA, CRYSTALLINE by its own get_state_name) as its shipped formation=ring: octahedron core, eight prisms on a circle at radius size*0.6 each turned outward, two caps.
sources.edge_core: [[edge_core]] learned that its set_lambda() is called by NOTHING in the repository, so in all three rooms the core stands green and alive for every value of λ there is — an object that can only ever draw the answer is the contradiction of the claim it is there to make. Exhibited at λ 0.40 as station=edge: translucent shell, bright counter-core, and the orbiting ring as what a still of a GPUParticles3D ring actually is, twenty dots, seeded at its own SCATTER_SEED.
sources.qfep_reactor: [[qfep_reactor]] learned the same disease independently in a second file the same day — _connect_to_sliders() waits on a group nothing ever joins, so current_lambda has stood at 0.4 everywhere, forever. Exhibited at λ 0.40 beside edge_core as station=edge, the smooth orb with its emission-sphere cloud at the source's own 0.35-to-0.30 ratio. It also supplies this artifact's second axis: `readout`, taken whole.
sources.transforming_pattern: [[transforming_pattern]] learned that the honest axis between it and preserved_pattern — the presence or absence of time — is exactly the axis a still cannot see, and declined it on the evidence, taking `concert` instead: not whether the grid changes but WHO CHANGES WITH WHOM. Exhibited at λ 0.55 as concert=superposition photographed at phase_lock = 2.0, the phase its own bench fixture pins.
sources.fluid_form: [[fluid_form]] learned that its own declared critical_parameter was the wrong axis — 'five intensities photograph as five degrees of lumpiness, which is size wearing a name' — and that its shader had never compiled, so the one shipped room had been rendering a bare sphere. Exhibited at λ 0.65 as flux=mixed: the fixed noise_gain 1.0 / sway_gain 0.3 pair evaluated on the CPU at freeze_time = 3.0, at the source's own body radius so the noise samples the same field.
sources.random_cubes: [[random_cubes]] learned that entropy is not a property of a pile but a count of the ways it could have been, so the count does not exist until you say WHICH macrostate you are counting — and that the invisible spawn box had to be drawn, because a confined pile without its frame reads as 'a smaller pile over there, which is size wearing a name'. That lesson is why this artifact's rail is always full length. Exhibited at λ 0.85 as macrostate=uniform, chance=all, REPLAYED from its own bench seed rather than modelled.
sources.particle_chaos: [[particle_chaos]] was found HOLLOW: an @export_enum and thirty lines specifying five silhouettes, with _build_particles() constructing the unconstrained cloud regardless — a sweep would have rendered five identical frames and called the axis inert, which would have been a fact about a missing function. Implemented, its lesson is that freedom is invisible with nothing to be free FROM. Exhibited at λ 1.00 (its own header: 'λ = 1 dissolution zone') as constraint=none: the isotropic ball, modelled as a still because the source's cloud lives on the GPU.

relationships.does_not_replace: The eight originals stay placed and keep their own axes. The promenade never re-runs a member's axis from the outside — each emblem is fixed at its source's OWN default — because letting a map drive them from here would fork eight vocabularies into a ninth. This is an addition for rooms that want the comparison, not an upgrade; the walk-scale encounter with one artifact alone is still the curriculum's spine, and it is what the synthesis hides.
relationships.refused_by_a_source: [[edge_core]]'s promotion explicitly declined to share `station` with [[fluid_form]] and [[rigid_sculpture]]: 'their line is phi (resist vs embrace change) and this one's is lambda (order vs chaos)... a shared word with two vocabularies would claim a kinship the geometry does not have.' That is a refusal of exactly the composition this artifact makes. It is therefore made EXPLICITLY and marked in geometry: at readout=lattice each standing body gets a marker at its TRUE (λ, φ) and a tie-line from its slot, and four of the eight tie-lines run off the λ axis because four of these bodies are φ arguments the promenade has projected. The equal spacing is likewise a lie about λ — 0.00 and 0.05 are one slot apart, and so are 0.40 and 0.40 — and the same tie-lines say so.

dna.default: extent=full, readout=numeral. A synthesis has no shipped placements, so the default is a design choice rather than a preservation duty, and this is the strongest single reading: all eight bodies up, in λ order, on the full rail, with both poles standing and the λ number etched on every plinth. It is the only value of `extent` at which the promenade is a spectrum rather than a sample. readout=numeral is the family's legacy rung and matches qfep_reactor, line, xyz_slider_plate and qfep_calibrator; it is also the rung the exhibit needs to be honest at all, since without the numbers the equal spacing passes unchallenged.
dna.was: synthesized from preserved_pattern, rigid_sculpture, edge_core, qfep_reactor, transforming_pattern, fluid_form, random_cubes and particle_chaos — eight artifacts promoted separately between 2026-08-03 and 2026-08-04, whose cross-member argument (that they are positions relative to one another) existed only in registry notes and in one sentence of edge_core's promotion.
dna.axis_extent: WHICH STRETCH OF THE λ LINE IS STOOD UP. The rail is ALWAYS full length and the occupied band is inlaid brighter on it — random_cubes' lesson taken directly, since without the full rail a crop would read as a smaller exhibit instead of a cropped one. full = all eight, the spectrum. ordered_half = λ 0.0..0.5, the four low bodies re-spread over the same rail at twice the size, F pole standing and no E pole. edge = λ 0.3..0.5, which is is_at_edge()'s own interval — the one qfep_reactor has always tested for and never drawn — leaving two bodies on a full-length rail with NEITHER POLE in the room. dissolved_half = λ 0.5..1.0, E(S) pole only. `edge` is the value that argues: with nothing to be an edge between, the edge is not narrow, it is everything.
dna.not_an_amount: ordered_half and dissolved_half hold the SAME number of stations at the SAME size and are opposite pictures — a frozen checkerboard, a crystal and two orbs against two orbs, a wave plate, a blob, a tumbling pile and a cloud. What varies is which part, not how much. This is the failure mode fluid_form and random_cubes were both promoted around and it is checked here rather than assumed.
dna.axis_readout: TAKEN CHARACTER FOR CHARACTER from qfep_reactor — one of this artifact's own sources — and behind it commons/primitives/line/line.gd, xyz_slider_plate.gd and qfep_calibrator: the word, the four values, the strictly additive rank ladder, and the rule that an unrecognised word reads as `numeral` rather than `none` so a typo cannot strip the placard off a live room. Eight tokens carry this exact list. none = eight bodies and no numbers, the spectrum as a procession you can see the order of and cannot check. numeral = the λ value etched on each plinth and the poles lettered F and E(S). gradation = plus the public scale: the λ rule along the whole walk, teeth every 0.1, and the edge band painted across 0.3..0.5, after which the equal spacing can be caught lying. lattice = plus the λ x φ plane the formula actually lives in, the edge band as a REGION, a true-position marker for every standing body and a tie-line from each emblem to its marker.
dna.kin: The reader is LOCAL rather than a call into XYZSliderPlate.readout_name(), because qfep_reactor's is local and matching the nearest kin matters more here than saving four lines; the one honest divergence from the canon is that the canon's alias table (ticks -> gradation, integers -> lattice) is not implemented, exactly as qfep_reactor does not implement it.
dna.declined: `regime`, the corpus's 15-carrier word for which named case of a system's behaviour is on show, and the obvious candidate: bifurcation_walkway — the SAME FOLDER, the same sequence, a walkable parameter line — carries it for exactly this act ('regime crops the r axis onto one behaviour class... a cropped chart is a chart of less; a cropped corridor is twelve metres of one condition'), and its value lists are per-system on all fifteen carriers, with bouncing_ball's list-refusal already on the record. The question transfers; the values cannot. On the λ line the behaviour classes ARE ALREADY NAMED — `station` = edge|order|chaos, which edge_core and qfep_reactor share character for character precisely so the two can be checked against each other. A `regime` list here would either be those three words with a fourth bolted on, forking a two-carrier vocabulary whose whole purpose is the check, or three fresh names for the same three conditions, which is worse. So the refusal is itself the finding: this axis is deliberately NOT about condition. It asks how much of the line is present — the one question no single body standing on the line can ask, and therefore the one a synthesis is for.
dna.declined_station: `station` (edge|order|chaos) for the same reason stated the other way round: adding a fourth value to a three-value list shared by two of this artifact's own sources would break the only check those two exist to provide. The referents differ too — station is a POINT on the line, extent is an INTERVAL of it.
dna.declined_chapter: `chapter` (facade_grammar_demo plus the five particle_randomness tokens), whose note reads 'the word chapter and the leading all are facade_grammar_demo's... the chapter names belong to this book', so a per-artifact value list is explicitly licensed and the mechanism is identical — filter a roster by a named section, re-lay the survivors. Refused only because a chapter is a section of a text, and these are contiguous intervals of a continuous parameter with neighbours on both sides. `edge` is not a chapter; it is the middle of one.
dna.declined_emblem_axes: A third axis re-running the members' own axes from here. Each emblem is fixed at its source's OWN default — checker, ring, edge, edge, superposition, mixed, uniform+all, none — because a synthesis that let a map drive its members would fork eight vocabularies into a ninth, and the plan's rule is that a synthesis never replaces its sources and must keep each member's argument legible inside it.
dna.declined_time: Everything time-domain. This file has no _process at all, which is both the discipline (the evidence is one still PNG per value) and the argument: preserved_pattern and rigid_sculpture were each promoted around the fact that the ABSENCE OF TIME cannot be an axis, and a promenade of positions is the same claim at exhibition scale.
dna.still_note: NO FIXTURE IS NEEDED AND NONE IS DECLARED — there is no clock in this file to pin. Every draw is seeded by a constant: edge_core's ring at its own SCATTER_SEED 40404, qfep_reactor's cloud at its own JITTER_SEED 40405, particle_chaos's ball at 20260806. random_cubes' pile is not modelled but REPLAYED — the same fifteen draws per cube in the source's own order (size, x, y, z, three rotations, hue, saturation, then three velocity and three angular components, the last six taken so the stream cannot drift and discarded so the emblem stands still) from its own bench seed 20260804 — so that emblem is literally the pile its sweep photographs. The two time-driven sources are frozen at the phases their own fixtures pin: transforming_pattern at phase_lock 2.0, fluid_form at freeze_time 3.0, reused rather than chosen so an emblem and its source's gallery tile are the same instant of the same object.
dna.geometry_note: Predicted, not measured — the numbers a measuring pass should confirm. At the default (extent=full, readout=numeral) the AABB is about 4.58 x 0.62 x 0.44 m: rail length 4.34, poles at +/- 2.29, plinths 0.30 tall with the tallest emblems (the two orbs and the blob) reaching about 0.60, depth from the 0.44 plinths. A crop re-spreads its survivors over the SAME 4.34 m at up to 2x — capped, because uncapped extent=edge would be 4x and put a 1.76 m plinth on a 4.34 m rail, making the union box a fact about the crop's furniture — so the widest variant is still 4.34 and the extent sweep reframes NOT AT ALL. Plinth height is held constant at 0.30 under every scale, so the promenade stays level and its seating in a room is identical at every value; only emblem height moves. readout rungs 2 and 3 lie flat on the floor in FRONT at z 0.76 +/- 0.42, growing the box in depth only (to about 1.18) and never in height — qfep_reactor made the same move for the same reason. Element count at extent=full, readout=lattice is about 265 MeshInstance3D plus 10 Label3D; nothing is a MultiMeshInstance3D, so no layers = 0 anchor is needed, and nothing carries collision.
dna.measurement_risk: A 7:1 STRIP, and the framing hint is derived rather than guessed. capture_config_sweep frames radius = half the AABB DIAGONAL at PAD 1.9 and FOV 34, from YAW 0.62 / PITCH -0.26. The default box gives a diagonal of about 4.52, so the unframed view is roughly 8.6 world units square and the subject — about 4.2 x 0.86 after foreshortening — lands near 5% of frame, which is inside the too-small-to-measure band. framing 0.62 brings the view to about 5.3, putting the subject at roughly 79% of width and 16% of height, near 13% of frame, with about a tenth of the frame as margin at each end. IF THE SWEEP CLIPS THE END STATIONS, RAISE IT TOWARD 0.75 AND NEVER LOWER IT BELOW 0.55: the ends of this line are its argument, and an exhibit about what is missing from the room must not have its ends cropped by the camera. Second risk: extent=edge is DELIBERATELY the emptiest frame — two emblems, no poles — so a large drop in subject percentage there is the finding, not a fault. Read it against the rail, which is present at full length in every value and is the fixed high-contrast reference the crop is legible against.

lambda_promenade.qfep_connection: The whole equation laid out as a walk. F stands at one end and E(S) at the other, and between them the eight bodies the laboratory has already built, each restating its own claim at icon scale with its λ etched underfoot. The point is not that λ explains all eight — it does not, and the promenade says so: half of these are φ arguments that have been projected onto the λ line to make it look continuous, and at readout=lattice the tie-lines measure exactly how far each one was moved. What the walk gives back is the thing every one of these artifacts was missing alone — a second term to be read against.

emergence_zone.name: Emergence Zone
emergence_zone.description: A zone where complexity emerges. Particles self-organize at the edge of chaos.
emergence_zone.qfep_connection: A zone where complexity emerges — particles self-organizing at the edge of chaos. The chapter's central claim made walkable: that structure worth having is not imposed (λ=0) nor absent (λ=1) but *emergent*, arising on its own in the thin habitable band. Stand in it and you stand where the project locates aliveness.

turing_pattern.name: Turing Pattern
turing_pattern.description: Reaction-diffusion Turing pattern. Spots, stripes, labyrinths.

dna.default: station=edge - the lineage segment for segment: translucent green shell at 32 segments and 16 rings, alpha 0.3, the bright inner sphere at 0.4x radius, the 100-particle orbiting ring, and _process running exactly as it did (the freeze branch is false, and the three new null guards can only be true for a value that removes the mesh they guard). All three placements - QFEP_Edge_Of_Chaos, Corridor_QFEP_Edge_Of_Chaos, Curation_Bay_qfeplaboratory_6 - are bare tokens, and apply_grid_config returns unless a token names `station` AND the word differs, so nothing rebuilds for them.
dna.was: five exports, all dials on the SAME appearance: core radius, pulse speed, pulse amount, rotation speed, particle count. No apply_grid_config, so no map token could reach any of them.
dna.note: The artifact's claim is a claim about a POSITION - life is not at order or at chaos but at the narrow boundary - and it could only ever draw the answer.
